cases.name: applied
cases.note: An acknowledgement that the runtime applied the artifact retires it.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The runtime therefore publishes an ingest acknowledgement, and the gateway retires an artifact from its durable queue only on receiving one.

cases.name: refused_malformed
cases.note: A refusal for malformed retires the artifact.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The bytes. They are not a well-formed artifact and will not become one.

cases.name: refused_bad_authenticator
cases.note: A refusal for bad_authenticator retires the artifact.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The bytes and the named key. The authenticator does not verify, and resending cannot change that.

cases.name: refused_binding_mismatch
cases.note: A refusal for binding_mismatch retires the artifact.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The bytes. The artifact is about another device, another key, or an artifact this runtime never sealed, or a receipt's range digest does not match the chain rows sealed for its range.

cases.name: refused_non_contiguous_range
cases.note: A refusal for non_contiguous_range retires the artifact.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The bytes. The claimed range is not a closed interval.

cases.name: refused_unrecognised_version
cases.note: A refusal for unrecognised_version keeps the artifact at the head of its lane until a relevant runtime state change.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: Receiver capability. A later release may interpret that version.

cases.name: refused_wrong_purpose
cases.note: A refusal for wrong_purpose keeps the artifact at the head of its lane until a relevant runtime state change.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: Receiver state. The purpose a `key_id` is held under is registry state, not something readable from the artifact.

cases.name: refused_unknown_key
cases.note: A refusal for unknown_key keeps the artifact at the head of its lane until a relevant runtime state change.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: Receiver state. A later release may ship the authority key.

cases.name: refused_retired_key
cases.note: A refusal for retired_key keeps the artifact at the head of its lane until a relevant runtime state change.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: Receiver state, resolved by operator action.

cases.name: refused_unknown_sequence
cases.note: A refusal for unknown_sequence keeps the artifact at the head of its lane until a relevant runtime state change.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: Receiver state. The envelope may not be sealed yet.

cases.name: refused_superseded
cases.note: A refusal for superseded retires the artifact.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The runtime's durable resolution of the disposition's subject, which never reverts.

cases.name: refused_restatement_conflict
cases.note: A refusal for restatement_conflict retires the artifact.
cases.head: retired
cases.clause: The bytes against a final record the runtime holds, verified and immutable, which never reverts.

cases.name: refused_unrecognised_reason
cases.note: A refusal naming a reason outside the vocabulary is held as a non-retiring refusal.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: A gateway accepts and retires on a reason before any runtime it serves sends it; a gateway that does not recognise a reason cannot retire the artifact, and holds it at the head of that device's lane as a non-retiring refusal.

cases.name: no_acknowledgement_after_store_fault
cases.note: The runtime's store faulted: it released the broker message and sent no acknowledgement. The head stays and is redelivered in a newly signed envelope.
cases.head: kept
cases.clause: The courier keeps the artifact, as it keeps any artifact it holds no acknowledgement for, and redelivers it in a newly signed envelope.
